coverage_rule: Every day and each venue must pass the pre-existing 95% traded/all-member gate; no shortened success window
SSE_membership_basis: Dated anchor plus three reviewed effective changes, with title-catalog triage and endpoint reconciliation; no independently observed complete daily SSE legal-membership/name table
return_basis: Daily arithmetic mean across all observed trading members (not an unweighted average of venue means), compounded as a descriptive changing-sample reference; first plotted close rebased to 100 for comparison
